description: This file is a shell script used for testing Windows named pipes within a project. It sets up prerequisites, runs a test to write to a named pipe, and compares expected outputs.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisite environment requirements, such as MINGW on Windows.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects successful execution of the enclosed commands.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: Utility to run specific test-related tools or commands.
